player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({piece}). Opponent is ({opp}). Submit moves as '[b1 c3]' (from → to). All pieces move like chess knights.
Each capture scores {score_per_capture} point. Game ends after {max_moves} moves or when a player has no legal move / no pieces. Higher score wins.

invalid_move.bad_format: Kuyilemba kanawa. Shimbu kanda ulikate "[b1 c3]".
invalid_move.not_your_piece: Chize chinapu chiyulo hi chihande chenu ko.
invalid_move.own_piece: Kanda muhasa kuhiluka mu chihanda cha lifuchi.

game_action.moved: Mutu yoze {player_id} te kakuza chihanda chenyi kufuma ku {frm} kuya kuli {to}.

outcome.no_pieces: Mutu yoze wakuzomboka {player_id} keshi ni mbonga.
